question: How is the actual failed pre-signal WSL launch preserved separately from the D180 retry without relabeling it as successful?
decision: Archive every failed-launch file byte-for-byte, retain its execution_failed receipt and exact setup revision, and distinguish local WSL access failure from source unavailability or biological results. This performs no signal reading or analysis.
strongest_rival: Discarding, overwriting or registering a failed launch as a successful scientific execution would conceal its actual status and partial outputs.
discriminator: Copy all eight actual failed-run files and a separate observed-access diagnostic; compare every input/output SHA-256 and retain original receipt bytes/status. Record original path, archive path, size and digest. Header/window signal files must be absent in the failed source.
exposure_record: The first frozen D180 attempt failed at wslpath before any header or research-window signal read. Failure logs/status and partial preparation artifacts are exposed. Read-only diagnostic confirmed sandbox Wsl/E_ACCESSDENIED and a successful approved local WSL translation outside the sandbox. The unchanged frozen D180 contract is retrying in a new directory; this metadata archive never reruns it.
biological_unit: Execution files and provenance records; no biological measurement or inferential unit is estimated.
nesting_and_overlap: Byte copies of one existing failed launch are the same records, not independent runs or biological evidence. The separate retry retains its own receipt and timing.
population_and_selection: All eight files from the actual failed-launch directory, plus the separately labeled observed-access diagnostic; no selective omission or status repair.
contrast: Exact input-versus-archived byte identity and unchanged failed status; no biological comparison.
endpoint: Recorded failed status, original frozen revision, original/archived paths, byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
methods: Standard-library file copies and independent source/destination SHA-256 equality, with guards requiring the exact failed analysis ID/status/exit code and no header or window-signal file in that source. Save one archive manifest and all original file bytes under failed_launch_v1.
missingness_and_exclusions: No omission, renaming of internal receipt fields, scientific reconstruction or overwritten source. Stop if any input/hash changes, destination exists, unexpected successful status or evidence of header/window-signal output.
multiplicity: Not applicable to exact metadata preservation. No statistical tests or scientific acceptance.
precision_basis: Exact byte hashes and file counts, not biological precision or a numerical effect margin.
interpretation_limit: Successful archival means the failure was preserved. It does not make the failed D180 execution successful, assess source signal, establish scientific validity or weaken any runtime or provenance gate.
stop_rule: Freeze this metadata contract/code and match every input hash before copying. Refuse unexpected status/ID/exit code, existing destinations or source/output hash disagreement. Preserve the source and any partial archive. Do not modify the failed receipt, original D180 contract/code or governing validators.
amendment_reason: Separate metadata-only preservation of the real WSL access failure; no change to the already frozen scientific analysis or its retry.
